description: Get internet-exchange and peering density near a lat/lon from PeeringDB, or the top peering facilities overall.

lat.description: Latitude of the site, e.g. 39.04 — with lon, returns the peering profile around it; omit both for the IXP directory

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

name: get_peering_intel
title: Get Peering Intel
